description: T6 — F_ℓ derivation via per-braid mass tower (canonical, post-2026-05-17 Li_2^q form)

context.purpose: Test whether per-braid mass tower alone (no SUPERSEDED ρ_q) gives correct lepton mass ratios

muon_scenario_A_figure_eight.braid: 4_1 figure-eight (canonical paper; using proton V̂_i as crude proxy)
muon_scenario_A_figure_eight.caveat: V̂_0=0.989, V̂_1=0.971 are PROTON-specific values from mass-endomorphism-tower.md line 362-363. Using them for muon is a CRUDE TEST; the framework does not publish muon-specific V̂_i.

verdict: FAR — >50% from CODATA; per-braid mass tower with PROTON V̂_i values DOES NOT give muon mass. Either V̂_i are muon-specific (unpublished) or the per-braid mass tower needs different inputs for leptons.
